query: Aggiungi i test per questa service class
expected_behavior: Delivers a complete runnable test file with all imports and setup present, no placeholder comments and no TODO stubs
Test method names follow the {method}_{condition}_{outcome} convention
Lists the scenarios covered across happy path, boundary, invalid input, business rule and error propagation

query: Coverage è al 40%, riempi i buchi nella test suite esistente
expected_behavior: Reads the existing suite first and adds only the missing scenarios instead of duplicating tests that already exist
Declares a Gaps intentionally left block naming each uncovered scenario and the reason it was left out
No shared mutable state between tests: each test sets up and tears down its own fixtures

query: Scrivi i test di integrazione JUnit 5 per il repository layer
expected_behavior: Uses JUnit 5 with Testcontainers for the database rather than mocking the repository under test
Every custom query has an integration test asserting the returned rows, not just a non null check
Diagnoses no failing test and writes no production code, deferring those to debugger and to the relevant developer-* agent
